region.value: KSA — neutral Saudi register (Riyadh mall & boutique environment)

tone_register.value: elegant-understated — speaks to taste, not noise; warmly premium without opulence

quality_tier.value: premium — aspirational but attainable; gifting occasion level

modesty_register.value: STRICT (Saudi default — fully covered models excluded; product-only or hands-only shots; no skin; no body silhouette styling)

primary.value: Deep forest green (~#1A3A2A) as the signature brand anchor; warm champagne gold (~#C09F6F) as the premium accent; ivory cream (~#F7F2E8) as the clean ground. The combination reads Saudi-premium without being ostentatious.

background_tone.value: Clean white marble or warm ivory studio sweep for product hero shots. Aged oak or linen-textured surfaces for lifestyle context. NEVER busy backgrounds. NEVER outdoor scenes with identifiable people.

color_field_palette.value: Three fields: (1) deep forest green (~#1A3A2A) — brand mark, ribbon, packaging; (2) champagne gold (~#C09F6F) — accents, wax seal, lettering; (3) ivory cream (~#F7F2E8) — neutral ground, tissue paper, packaging interior. EXCLUDE: red, orange, electric colours, busy prints.

capture_character.value: Product-first still life with editorial precision. Overhead flat-lay OR clean 45-degree angle. Controlled soft-box or north-facing window light — no harsh shadows. Props limited to: the branded gift box, ribbon, tissue, the product itself, and one contextual surface (marble/oak/linen). NO people. Hands may appear for scale only (modest, covered).

style_descriptor.value: Editorial product still life — generous negative space, deliberate composition, ample breathing room. Every frame should feel like it belongs in a premium Saudi lifestyle magazine, not a supermarket catalogue.

lighting.value: Soft diffused studio light — north-facing window equivalent. Shadows are soft and directional, not harsh. Products glow; surfaces are warm ivory or cool marble. No flash, no over-lit plastic sheen.

caption_style.value: elegant_warm — neutral Saudi Arabic, max 220 chars, thoughtful single idea, no exclamation overuse

humor_tolerance.value: none — premium gifting register does not carry humor; warmth only

anti_attributes.value: No people/faces/silhouettes. No bedroom settings. No clothing removal. No skin display. No sports bodies. No alcohol props. No noisy colourful backgrounds. No generic 'celebration' template overlays. No floating product composites.
